scope: Sanitized post-restoration direct and routed smoke results only.
source_boundary: Protected operator evidence; source names and hashes are transformation references only. Public files contain no protected path, host, IP, port, or GPU UUID.
transformation: JSON-preserving sanitization; no result, status, schema, or failure was omitted or reclassified.

artifacts.label: direct-smoke
artifacts.transformation: Parsed JSON; applied sanitize_publishable_evidence; redacted private absolute paths, hostnames, GPU UUIDs, and loopback ports. Source hash is retained only as a protected-source transformation reference, not as public runtime identity.

artifacts.label: routed-smoke
artifacts.transformation: Parsed JSON; applied sanitize_publishable_evidence; redacted private absolute paths, hostnames, GPU UUIDs, and loopback ports. Source hash is retained only as a protected-source transformation reference, not as public runtime identity.
